{{Quote|Let Splendid Ap, who is stupid, correct the disorder.|Tilotny|<ref name="TTaS" />}}
'''Splendid Ap''' was one of the four [[Bedlam Spirits]] that inhabited the region near the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they learned to take on physical forms and encountered [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]], where she had been [[Mission to Bedlam|forced]] to land by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. The spirits called [[Tilotny]] and [[Horliss-Horliss]] decided to play with Organa and her [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Three stormtroopers|pursuers]], eventually [[Death/Legends|killing]] them all. After they tired of playing, Tilotny let Splendid Ap clean up the mess; he revived Organa and the stormtroopers but accidentally [[Time travel/Legends|transported]] the latter 8,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] into the [[Time/Legends|past]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|And now everyone is throwing shapes and it is spoiled and not a new thing! See&hellip;even Cold Danda Sine and Splendid Ap have thrown a shape!|Tilotny|<ref name="TTaS" />}}
[[File:TheresASplendidApForThat.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Splendid Ap resurrects Leia Organa and three stormtroopers.]]
An omnipotent, transdimensional being, Splendid Ap was one of the [[Bedlam Spirits]] who existed in the stark whiteness that digested [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] near the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]].<ref name="TEA" /> The spirits were generally non-corporeal beings but when they experimented with [[Time/Legends|time]], matter, and [[Realspace/Legends|space]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|248|Tilotny}}</ref> the spirit known as [[Tilotny]] discovered how to take on a shape. Splendid Ap and his fellow spirits, [[Horliss-Horliss]] and [[Cold Danda Sine]], copied Tilotny's newfound ability and materialized on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]] at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TTaS" />

As the group discussed their new forms and surroundings, they met [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who had been forced to land on the planet and was being [[Mission to Bedlam|pursued]] by [[Three stormtroopers|three]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Tilotny, who believed herself to have created the world around them, claimed to have created Organa and her pursuers too and she and Horliss-Horliss began to play with the lifeforms. Before long, all four of the mortals were [[Death/Legends|dead]]; Organa's [[Heart/Legends|heart]] was turned to [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] by Horliss-Horliss, while Tilotny crystallized one stormtrooper and merged the other two into a single mass of [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. Soon tiring of their game, Tilotny, Cold Danda Sine and Horliss-Horliss decided to leave, with Tilotny instructing Splendid Ap to clean up the mess they had made. Splendid Ap restored the beings to life and their original forms but, failing to fully understand time and space, unwittingly [[Time travel/Legends|sent]] the stormtroopers 8,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] into the past.<ref name="TTaS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|No, Splendid Ap! The essence of time is sequence! One place at a time, Splendid Ap! One place at a time!|The Bedlam Spirits explain time to Splendid Ap|<ref name="TTaS" />}}
[[File:SplendidAps.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Splendid Ap creates copies of himself.]]
Despite his power, Splendid Ap struggled to understand time and space. After taking a physical form for the first time, he managed to produce six copies of himself, failing to understand that there should only be one copy of him at a time. Though he tried his best to overcome his lack of understanding of time when restoring the mortals to life, he accidentally sent the stormtroopers 8,000 years into the past, leaving them stranded on the planet. Splendid Ap was somewhat withdrawn from his peers; he spoke a different [[Language/Legends|language]] and did not get involved in their discussions on time and space or their interactions with the beings they encountered on the planet. The others looked down on his inability to comprehend time and Tilotny considered him to be stupid. In his corporeal form, Splendid Ap had a conical shape and was pink in color.<ref name="TTaS" />

==Powers and abilities==
Like the other Bedlam Spirits, Splendid Ap was an omnipotent being,<ref name="TEA" /> capable of manipulating time and mass, though his poor understanding of such things caused him difficulties when using his powers. An abstract entity by nature, he had the power to take on a physical form and was capable of creating several copies of himself that existed simultaneously. He could also [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitate]] objects and alter the beings he encountered, restoring Organa and the stormtroopers to life and their original forms after they were killed by the others, and was capable of sending them back in time.<ref name="TTaS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Splendid Ap was created by [[Alan Moore]] for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story ''[[Tilotny Throws a Shape]]'', which was published in the [[Marvel Comics]] UK comic book [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 154|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 154]] in [[February]] [[1982]]. ''Tilotny Throws a Shape'' was illustrated by [[John Stokes]] and was originally published in black and white.<ref name="TOS">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20090309.html|text=The ''Star Wars'' EU/ ''Watchmen'' Connection}}</ref><ref name="ESBM154">[[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 154|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 154]]</ref> It was later colored when reprinted by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[1996]]'s [[Classic Star Wars: Devilworlds 2|''Classic Star Wars: Devilworlds'' 2]], giving Splendid Ap his pink appearance.<ref name="TOS" /><ref name="CSW:D2">[[Classic Star Wars: Devilworlds 2|''Classic Star Wars: Devilworlds'' 2]]</ref> The character is also mentioned in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which established him as a Bedlam Spirit.<ref name="TEA" /> Author [[Joseph Bongiorno|Joe Bongiorno]] planned to detail Splendid Ap and the other Bedlam Spirits in a ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' article entitled "[[Supernatural Encounters in the Star Wars Universe]]," but the article was never completed after the magazine was canceled.<ref name="Lostworlds">{{WebCite|url=http://home.earthlink.net/~kcfurman/rpg.html#supernaturalencounters|text=Short Stories and RPG Materials|work=Star Wars Lostworlds|archivedate=20050830160143}}</ref>

Whereas the original comic shows Splendid Ap resurrecting Organa and the stormtroopers after Tilotny refuses,<ref name="TTaS" /> ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' incorrectly states that Tilotny restored the beings.<ref name="CSWE" /> The error was acknowledged by author [[Pablo Hidalgo]] during a [[The ForceCast|ForceCast]] interview in late 2008.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|pablog|146|What I meant to Say on the Forcecast&hellip;}}</ref>
